data.content: {"requirements":[{"unit_ids":["u1"],"source_quote":"Task titles are mandatory; cannot be empty.","kind":"validation_rule","statement":"A task title is required and an empty title must be rejected on task creation or update."},{"unit_ids":["u2"],"source_quote":"Due Date cannot be earlier than the Creation Date.","kind":"validation_rule","statement":"A task's Due Date must not be earlier than its Creation Date."},{"unit_ids":["u3"],"source_quote":"Task titles cannot be longer than 100 characters.","kind":"validation_rule","statement":"A task title must not exceed 100 characters."},{"unit_ids":["u4"],"source_quote":"Deleting a task requires a prompt confirmation.","kind":"frontend","statement":"Deleting a task must first show a confirmation prompt that the user must accept before the task is deleted."},{"unit_ids":["u5"],"source_quote":"Success or error messages must be displayed after create/update/delete actions.","kind":"frontend","statement":"After each create, update or delete action, the UI must display a success or error message reflecting the outcome."},{"unit_ids":["u6"],"source_quote":"Optimistic UI updates are not allowed: if a Backend action fails, the Frontend must not reflect a successful state.","kind":"constraint","statement":"The Frontend must not show a successful state for an action before the Backend confirms it, and must not show success when the Backend action fails."}]}
